Container.Name: sharedrive
Container.Overview: Sharedrive — self-hosted private file drive with user management, per-user quotas, file sharing, admin dashboard, audit logging, and Cloudflare tunnel support. Requires sharedrive-postgres and sharedrive-redis to be running first.
Container.Requires: 1. Docker network "cloudflare" must already exist (shared with your cloudflared container). 2. Docker network "privatedrive-net" must exist. Create with: docker network create privatedrive-net 3. sharedrive-postgres must be running. 4. sharedrive-redis must be running.

Config.Name: External URL
Config.Description: Full public URL of your Sharedrive instance, e.g. https://drive.yourdomain.com — used to build share links in emails.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Usually the same value as External URL.

Config.Name: Postgres Host
Config.Description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL container. Must match the container name of sharedrive-postgres.

Config.Name: Postgres Port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port. Leave as 5432 unless you changed it.

Config.Name: Postgres Database
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name. Must match the value set in sharedrive-postgres.

Config.Name: Postgres User
Config.Description: PostgreSQL user. Must match the value set in sharedrive-postgres.

Config.Name: Postgres Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password. Must match the value set in sharedrive-postgres.

Config.Name: Redis Address
Config.Description: Address of the Redis container in host:port format. Must match the container name of sharedrive-redis.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Secret key for signing session tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Backup HMAC Secret
Config.Description: Secret key for HMAC-signing backup exports. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: TOTP Encrypt Key
Config.Description: AES-256-GCM key for encrypting TOTP secrets at rest. Must be exactly 32 bytes — generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Device Trust Secret
Config.Description: Secret key for HMAC-signing device-trust tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Default User Quota (bytes)
Config.Description: Default storage quota for new users, in bytes. Default is 10 GB (10737418240).

Config.Name: WebDAV Enabled
Config.Description: Enable WebDAV access for mounting the drive as a network drive.

Config.Name: Open Registration
Config.Description: Allow anyone to register an account. Set to true only if you want public sign-up.

Config.Name: Require TOTP for Admins
Config.Description: Require admin accounts to have TOTP two-factor authentication enabled.

Config.Name: Files Storage
Config.Description: Path on the host where uploaded files are stored. Ensure this directory exists and has sufficient free space.

Config.Name: Backups Storage
Config.Description: Path on the host where exported backup archives are stored.
